name: B10-0155/2025 (PfE) – The need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for EU money already set aside for Syria to be redirected towards helping Syrian refugees in Europe return home and rebuild their lives there. It also urges the new Syrian government to protect Christians and other religious and ethnic minorities. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law or spending.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks for aid to be shifted to return and reintegration programmes.
- **Who it affects:** Syrian refugees in Europe and the new Syrian government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and the new Syrian government for their response.
